scope: Sequential ABBA live-camera cadence comparison. Same model, search and threshold. Every processed RGB retained; file writes after all timed blocks. Keep all startup/outlier samples. Live views may differ; not matched-scene accuracy or independent arena qualification.
selection: Report every block and all-sample aggregate. Prefer higher cadence only if both observed 10 FPS blocks have higher completed-result throughput than both 5 FPS blocks, aggregate p95 sensor age does not increase, timestamps are valid/increasing, and no throttle flags occur. This gate permits further research only, never deployment or an accuracy claim.
